ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: The Bazaar
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The deal is the gameplay: for a Jawa, information is loot, reading the trader is a skill, and walking away richer than you should have is the fantasy. Vanilla trade is a spreadsheet checkout; The Bazaar replaces the trade window with a searchable, sortable, column-configurable grid, intel layers gated by Social skill and found artifacts, and a whole-deal haggle duel at confirm time.
BAZAAR_WINDOW_GRID_1, slice 1 (this build): plugin def scaffolding (RM_BazaarColumnDef/BadgeDef/TabDef/IntelLayerDef + worker base classes), the RM_Window_Bazaar Dialog_Trade subclass, and a Mod Settings skeleton.
NOT YET SHIPPED: the WindowStack.Add Harmony intercept that actually substitutes RM_Window_Bazaar for vanilla's Dialog_Trade, the virtualized grid body, the price engine, the haggle duel and banter. See `design/RimMandrake/bazaar_trade_window_design.md` for the full design and `Source/RM_Window_Bazaar.cs` for the specific hazard the intercept still owes (double TradeSession.SetupWith).
No DLC required. Vanilla TradeSession/TradeDeal/Tradeable are untouched by this mod at every stage of the design — it never rewrites trade execution, only the window drawn over it.
